scope: Pinned Supabase PostgreSQL single-attempt HBA publication, parser validation and durable reload-signal acknowledgment witness. Not activation confirmation, successful operation settlement or supervisor integration.
checks: host headroom checked before bounded probe
owned exact container is isolated and memory bounded
neighbor role is unprivileged without inherited memberships
actual HBA apply has zero parser errors and reload acknowledgment
completion witness durably binds exact journal and desired bytes
valid execution cannot dispatch apply twice
valid publication retirement preserves unknown activation
invalid applied HBA cannot produce completion witness
invalid execution cannot dispatch apply twice
invalid publication retirement preserves unknown activation
fixture baseline restored after applied-operation probes
exact disposable container absent from successful inventory
